description: A pint of raw ether and a rag. Not the smart choice, but here we are.

effects.comeon_message: You put the rag over your face and breathe in. The smell is overpowering.

events.text: [trip]The floor lurches sideways and the room smears into long cold streaks.[/trip]
[trip]Your thoughts arrive out of order, each one wrapped in cotton wool.[/trip]
[trip]You're extremely far away from your own hands.[/trip]
[trip]A chemical wind blows straight through your skull and out the other side.[/trip]
[trip]The room swings queasily back into place, reeking of solvent, and you with it.[/trip]

effects.onset_message: The floor tilts and the lights go soft. You're dizzy.

overdose.message: One rag too many. You black out.

phases.comedown_message: The room stops tilting. You can still smell it.
phases.end_message: You're steady again, and a headache is coming on.

effects.take_line: You soak the rag and hold it over your face.

withdrawal.message: You're dizzy, and you keep smelling it when it isn't there.

stages.easing: It settles into an ordinary bad day, which is a relief.
stages.onset: You can smell it on your hands, though there's no rag anywhere near you.
stages.peak: You throw up, and it doesn't help, and then you throw up again.
stages.rising: The room won't stay still, and closing your eyes makes it worse.
stages.tail: You're steady, but you still catch the smell in places it shouldn't be.

name: ether
